verdict.rationale: Shortwave shows some bulk-style handling: a one-click 'sweep away the rest' to clear non-important email (docs-29), AI filters that automatically label, star or archive mail from plain-English rules (docs-15), and triggers that organize threads automatically (docs-1). A user reports clearing a weeks-old backlog in 10 minutes (comm-8). However, the evidence never explicitly describes selecting many existing threads and acting on them at once, or having the AI assistant run one action across a large set of emails. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-select or AI-driven bulk actions across many existing threads, stated scope or limits of bulk operations, and independent hands-on confirmation of bulk actions run by the AI.
